name: Statistics and Data Science
notes: To be admitted to the full major, students must complete all pre-major courses with a 2.5 or higher UC grade-point average. All pre-major courses must be completed with a grade of 'C' or better. Students are permitted to repeat a maximum of two pre-major courses. Only one repeat is allowed in each course. Preparation courses are excluded from the pre-major GPA, but will apply to the overall major GPA. Students must complete Computer Science 8 and either 9 or 16 with a grade of 'C' or better. Only one repeat is allowed in each preparation for the major and pre-major requirement. Entry into the pre-major does not guarantee admission to full major status. P/NP grading not allowed for any major course. At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major. With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors.

groups.label: Pre-Major
groups.note: Either Math 4A, 4B, 6A, or 6B must be completed with a grade of 'B' or better to take Math 8 or PSTAT 8. Math 8 is a prerequisite for all upper division Math courses except Math 117, 104A, 104B, and 104C. If you plan to take additional upper division Math courses, you must take Math 8.

groups.label: Preparation for the Major
groups.note: CMPSC 9 is recommended over CMPSC 16. Also, students cannot get credit for CMPSC 8 at UCSB if transferring in credit for CMPSC 9 or 16, so please see the Department advisors in such instances.

groups.label: Upper-Division Major - C
groups.note: 24 units from elective PSTAT courses. Math 100A-B, 101A-B, 102A-B, 193; PSTAT 109, 182T (or W 182T), 188, 190, 193 will NOT apply to the major. Guide to PSTAT Courses: Probability and Statistics Theory: PSTAT 120A (or W 120A), 120B, 120C; Data Science and Applied Statistics courses: PSTAT 100, 105, 115, 122, 123, 126, 127, 130, 131, 132, 134, 135, 174 (or W 174), 175, 197A-B-C; Actuarial and Financial Mathematics courses: PSTAT 170, 171, 172A-B, 173, 176, 183; Stochastic Modelling courses: PSTAT 160A (or W 160A), 160B; For students preparing to continue to graduate school: PSTAT 160A (or W 160A), 160B, PSTAT 199 (research), and at least one UD Math course (Math 117 and/or Math 108A) is highly recommended.

groups.label: Upper-Division Major - D
groups.note: 8 units from: other PSTAT courses not used above; Math 104A-B-C, 108A-B, 111A-B-C, 117, 118A-B-C, 132A-B; Econ 100B, 101, 134A-B. Math 100A-B, 101A-B, 102A-B, 193; PSTAT 109, 182T (or W 182T), 188, 190, 193 will NOT apply to the major.
